# Turkey Postal Codes Database (Türkiye Posta Kodları)

> Türkiye posta kodları veritabanı. 81 il, 2,771 posta kodu. Turkey postal codes for all 81 provinces with district names.

This repository contains a database of turkey postal codes database (türkiye posta kodları) covering 1 datasets with 2,771 records.

## Available Formats

- SQLite database (.db) — ready to query
- SQL dump (.sql) — import into MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, etc.
- Excel, CSV, PDF — available at https://listbase.org

## Data Structure

Table: `postal_codes`
- `postal_code` (TEXT NOT NULL)
- `city_code` (TEXT)
- `city_name` (TEXT NOT NULL)
- `district_name` (TEXT)
- `neighbourhood_count` (INTEGER)

## Download

- GitHub Releases: https://github.com/listbase-org/postal-codes-turkey-databases/releases
- Excel/CSV/PDF: https://listbase.org/tr/geography/
